fields.description: The ERPNext DocType this submission log entry relates to (e.g. `Item` for item registration submissions to KRA eTIMS). More DocTypes will be added to this list as later milestones wire up Sales Invoice and other submissions.
fields.label: Reference Doctype

fields.description: Link to the specific document (of the type named in Reference Doctype) that this submission log entry tracks.
fields.label: Reference Name

fields.description: The kind of eTIMS submission this log entry represents (e.g. `Item Registration`). More submission types will be added as later milestones add Sales Invoice/credit note submissions.
fields.label: Submission Type

fields.description: Current state of this submission attempt. Transitions between these states are driven by future retry/scheduler logic — not wired up yet in this milestone.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Number of submission attempts made so far for this log entry. Incremented by future retry logic — not wired up yet in this milestone.
fields.label: Attempt Count

fields.description: Timestamp at which a future retry scheduler should next attempt this submission. Not consumed by any scheduler yet in this milestone.
fields.label: Next Retry At

fields.description: Unique key used to prevent duplicate submissions to KRA eTIMS for the same logical request. Exact format (e.g. a hash of payload plus reference) is decided in a later milestone; for now this field only enforces uniqueness at the database level.
fields.label: Idempotency Key

fields.description: Raw JSON payload sent to KRA eTIMS for this submission (read-only; populated by future submission logic).
fields.label: Request Payload

fields.description: Raw JSON payload received back from KRA eTIMS for this submission (read-only; populated by future submission logic).
fields.label: Response Payload

fields.description: Human-readable error detail captured if this submission failed, for debugging and display in the log list.
fields.label: Error Message
